title: Ivaldi version-control webhook event v1
description: The normalized payload the gateway publishes when a version-control provider reports a webhook, and the control plane consumes. The gateway verifies the provider's webhook and normalizes it into this shape before publishing.

delivery_id.description: Provider's delivery ID; a redelivery of the same event has the same ID.

route_key.description: Platform-wide key the gateway routes the webhook by, such as github:github.com:42.

provider.description: Version-control provider that sent the webhook.

host_url.description: Address of the provider, such as https://github.com or a self-hosted server.

installation_id.description: Provider ID of the installation the event concerns, such as a GitHub App installation ID.

occurred_at.description: When the provider says the event occurred, as RFC 3339 in UTC.

repository.description: The repository the provider reports, with the metadata a Source stores.

external_id.description: Provider's stable repository ID; unlike the name, it survives renames and transfers.

full_name.description: Current repository name, such as acme/checkout.

default_branch.description: Current default branch, such as main.

clone_url.description: URL the data plane clones the repository from.

web_url.description: URL of the repository in the provider's web interface.

archived.description: Whether the provider archived the repository.
